Scope: the Low Process RBF unit, an outside mosque, a pump shed and a GRP water tank, with site works, concrete, masonry, finishes, pre-engineered structures, and mechanical and electrical systems including fire fighting, fire alarm and solar power.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. The project is 98.5% complete against 82.4% planned, 16.1% ahead of the baseline (SPI 1.195). This week's progress was 2.0%, below the 3.8% planned for the week.

The works are nearly finished, but the reported completion forecast is out of date. The weekly report forecasts completion of all works on 15-Oct-2026, six days before its own data date, while close-out is 67.2% and electrical works 98.5% complete. Testing and commissioning is still planned for 09-Dec-2026 to 19-Dec-2026, and the contract completion date is 02-Jan-2027. The forecast needs to be updated.

Data notes

  • The forecast completion of all works (15-Oct-2026) is before the report's data date of 21-Oct-2026, while close-out is 67.2% complete and the Testing sheet plans testing and commissioning for 09-Dec-2026 to 19-Dec-2026.
  • Milestones: mobilisation and the existing condition survey have baseline dates of 31-Mar-2025, before the contract award of 25-Jan-2026. Long-lead procurement is marked actual with a date of 27-Oct-2026, after the data date; the summary panel gives its latest plan as 03-Oct-2026 while the Milestones sheet gives 27-Oct-2026. The change column shows 0 days for short-lead procurement, the warehouse and the mosque, although their forecasts are 54 to 66 days before baseline.
  • S-curve: the Physical-Chart Data sheet divides earned man-hours by 241,519.85 (the crushed plan total) for April to September but by 224,320 for October. This report uses 224,320, the budget in the Progress sheet, for every month; with the sheet's own percentages September would be 88.4% instead of 95.2%.
  • Only the latest weekly report was used. This-week quantities are shown as "–" because the report has no previous-week figures, and the S-curve table has only this week.
  • Asphalt: the Major Quantities sheet and the Lookahead sheet report the base and wearing courses as 100% installed, but the Procurement sheet lists both as "Ready for delivery" and the Project Summary layout marks the wearing course as "Not Started". Their Plan to Date cells are blank and the variance column shows the full quantity.
  • Procurement: the Procurement sheet shows 86 of 108 items delivered, but the summary panel shows 95 of 95 materials on site. The sheet header still reads "as of 26-Jul-2026". Finishes and Specialties are reported 100% physically complete although 6 of 11 finishes items and 2 of 3 specialties items are not delivered.
  • Manpower: October non-manual actual is 13 in the monthly table, 16 in the Manpower sheet summary and 14 in the weekly report panel.
  • HSE: the weekly report panel shows 1 first-aid case, 2 near misses and 1 fire incident; the HSE-Stat sheet shows 2 first-aid cases, 9 near misses year to date (0 cumulative) and no fire incidents.
  • The hidden PV-PH and PV sheets hold planned-value data for another project (HAL1-05-1, Civil Defense Fire Station in Hail Industrial City, 2024–2025). They were not used.
  • The Invoice Log shows a revised contract value of 21,100,000, an estimate at completion of 20,900,000 and potential changes of 200,000 next to the 9,554,134 contract value. Invoice 1 and the Lookahead sheet use project ID NJR1-01-007, and the Lookahead names Mohammed Alharbi as project manager.
  • The Project Summary sheet splits the contract value by component differently from the Progress sheet (for example Site Works 1,067,430 against 682,299), though both total 9,554,134. Its planned 77.85% is the cost-based figure, not the physical 82.43%.
  • The Issues log and the Risk Register are empty, so the issues and risks section is left out. The weekly quality score is 0.8878 in every week since April. Several summary cells show #REF!.
  • The file is "Weekly Report #29"; this report uses project week 33 (days since site handover divided by 7), which matches "Current Contract Weeks: 33 of 44" in the Milestones sheet.
